bayts.text: He protects me, (unto) the Gardens, from what is not praiseworthy, a noble Messenger who visited our house: Aḥmad.
An interceding Messenger among creatures has protected me from harm, death and ignorance forever: Muḥammad.
Muḥammad, the Chosen, there is no creature like him: to his praises you have returned, and returning is more praiseworthy.
There came to me, by the leave of Allah — Whose gifts are abundant —, a beloved bearer of glad tidings, and harm was already extinguished.
There has already come to me, on land, the precedence of the Prophet of creation over every creature: through him creation finds support.
My praise of the Messenger of Allah led my request to me, and no slanderer who belies ever makes for me.
My love for my Lord, possessed of gratitude, for the Prophet, a noble Messenger, whose like is not born.
Whoever thought that the Followed, Muḥammad, resembles one born who has passed or who will be born has already lied.
My intercessor Muḥammad, my imām, called me to my praise; and whoever does not love me is driven away.
I have known, with the pious, the land and the (heavenly) assembly, that the Followed is the master of creation, unique.
Whenever I praised the Chosen, I suddenly obtained (a gift) by which I become glad tidings for whoever always prostrates.
I have praised the Bountiful, who gives like the foaming sea; and from his bounty (come) knowledge, safety and gold.
Unique, whenever he visited or was visited, forever, he appeared putting to shame the deceiver who does not prostrate.
Noble: when I met him, he led the wishes to me with gladness and safety; and my Lord I worship.
Whoever refused the religion of him whose religion is guidance has gone astray, and disappointed is he by whom the Lord of creation is not worshipped.
My gratitude to my Lord (is) through my praising Muḥammad: upon him the two peaces of Allah, as long as He is praised.
